card.name: Open-source license notice wording
card.fires_on: Words inside copyright and open-license statements, just before the license name is expected, such as 'under the', 'under a' or 'Creative Commons Attribution-No'. It also fires in free-software freedom lists.

modes.label: Before license name
modes.description: Linking words after 'licensed under' or 'free under' where a license title comes next.
modes.example: This work is licensed under<< a>> Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-No Der

modes.label: Inside license titles
modes.description: Parts of a Creative Commons title or version number before the word License.
modes.example: free under the Creative Commons Attribution<<-No>> Derivative Works 3.0 License

modes.label: Free software text
modes.description: Words in free-software terms or freedom lists.
modes.example: This library is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the<< same>> terms as Perl itself, either Perl version

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word license (or licence, licensing) next.
card.plain: It lights up in copyright notices where the next word is likely to be 'license'.
